history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Acquisition Planning and Requisitioning Unit, in close coordination with the Procurement Section and the Chief Finance and Budget Officer, ensured that all material purchase requirements for 2025 were thoroughly reviewed and processed strictly at the minimum levels necessary. All acquisitions were aligned with the Mission’s drawdown and liquidation timeline to avoid any unnecessary financial obligations being incurred.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration ensured that all material purchase requirements for 2025 were thoroughly reviewed and processed strictly at the minimum levels necessary, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
